title: Use wide screens on the site: wider column from 1500px, whole-page zoom from 2000px

comments.author: home
comments.text: Done on fix/wide-screens: site.css widens --max to 1320px from 1500px and zooms the page 1.25/1.5/1.75 from 2000/2600/3200px; util.js tooltip placement divides by the page zoom (checked at 3600px: tooltips centred, 14px above). Same CSS as hard-decisions.anth.us. Build 415 pages, 43/43 tests.

right_now_summary: The site now uses wider columns and page zoom on very wide screens, with tooltips adjusted and tests passing.
